card.name: Just before milli- and micro- units
card.fires_on: The space or last digit of a number right before a milli- or micro- unit such as ms, msec, microseconds, mcg or micromolar. It also fires on words like "every" or "for" that lead into a short time span.

modes.label: Space before a time value
modes.description: The space after a phrase like "hold the data for" and before a number of milliseconds.
modes.example: each cell is guaranteed to hold the data for<< >>16 ms without refresh.

modes.label: Last digit before a small unit
modes.description: The final digit of a number that is followed by milliseconds, microseconds or micromolar.
modes.example: Greater than 50<<0>> milliseconds OR Increase from baseline of 6

modes.label: Lead-in to a short interval
modes.description: A word such as "every" before a number of microseconds.

card.writes: It promotes micro, milli and mu unit prefixes, so the next word is likely a small-scale unit like milliseconds or microseconds.
card.plain: It signals that a milli- or micro- unit, such as ms or microseconds, is about to follow the number.
